title: Research Decision Brief
main_path: deterministic validator rejects illegal operators, missing metrics, and direction mismatches
Research Agent emits ACCEPT / REJECT / NEED_MORE_DATA / MODIFY
user report has only four blocks: what was tested, what the results were, current judgment, next action
critic_path: Critic must not be a mandatory pre-experiment gate
comparison: Single-prompt remains the baseline or fallback
carry_over_measurement_fix: If a falsification condition requires per-fold signal_accuracy, the ResultPacket must report it. positive_fold_ratio must not substitute.
